subject.title: [Feature]: Deeplink/contentIntent support in system.notify for Android nodes

question: Should this issue be resolved by the narrow tap-to-open-OpenClaw behavior in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100888, or should this issue require a deeplink/contentIntent parameter before it can close?
rationale: The issue asks about deeplink/contentIntent support, while the open candidate fix deliberately avoids arbitrary deeplinks for security reasons and routes broader deeplink policy to a separate issue.

options.title: Accept narrow tap fix
options.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100888 to make notification taps open OpenClaw and leave raw/allowlisted deeplink launch to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88293.

options.title: Require deeplink contract here
options.body: Keep the candidate PR insufficient and design an allowlisted contentIntent/deeplink contract before resolving this issue.

options.title: Keep notifications display-only
options.body: Decline notification-triggered launch behavior and close the candidate PR without changing `system.notify` tap behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow tap fix
recommendation.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100888 to make notification taps open OpenClaw and leave raw/allowlisted deeplink launch to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88293.

likelyOwner.reason: @steipete is assigned to this issue and authored the open candidate fix that embodies the product/security choice.
